name: Dominica
summary: Dominica follows English-derived common law and no forced heirship was found. It has an International Exempt Trust Act (1997). No private foundation law was found and the Hague Trusts Convention is not in force.
foreign_law_note: No source read states Dominica's conflict rule for a foreign national's estate. Common-law rule: movables follow the law of the domicile, land follows local law. Not confirmed in local statute for this jurisdiction.
trust_note: Dominica is not in the HCCH status table. The International Exempt Trust Act (No. 10 of 1997) was amended in 2015 and 2016 (contents not read). No foundation statute was found.
open_questions: No source read confirms Dominica has no forced heirship or family provision law; this rests on its common-law system.
Whether a foundation statute exists was not confirmed.
Contents of the Exempt Trust Act and its amendments not read.
Private foundations: no source found either way; not finding a foundation law is not evidence that there is none.
